Name: Food on the Table
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod gives NPCs (especially spouses and roommates) the ability to eat food items placed on furniture.


[size=4][b]Placing Food[/b][/size]

In the vanilla game, you can place items on some furniture using the right mouse button.

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10855]Furniture Display Framework[/url] installed, this mod will find food placed in display slots. E.g. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10884]Table Settings[/url].


[size=4][b]Eating[/b][/size][size=4][b] Food
[/b][/size]
NPCs will eat food that they love, like, and are neutral about, in that order.

NPCs will not eat food they don't like.

Spouses and roommates will walk to the nearest, best food in the farmhouse when they are hungry (by default every 5 hours).

Spouses and roommates will gain friendship points based on how much they like the food (default 50% of their gift value).

This mod should also trigger the fed spouse status for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3379]Another Hunger Mod[/url] (you can turn this off in the config).


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
